D1.instructions: Does the cited house evidence already establish exactly the requested scoped result? Distinguish a proved sub-result from a still OPEN full construction. Assess only the case and its scope, not unrelated graph hits.

D2.instructions: Which next action follows the case evidence and current restrictions? This is advisory classification, not permission to act. Reuse existing results before doing new work. Explicit suspension overrides production.

criteria.reaproveitar: Requested scoped result already exists; reuse and cite it.
criteria.completar: Existing partial work needs an authorized missing part.
criteria.novo: Truly absent work is explicitly authorized and not suspended.
criteria.suspender: Current instructions or unresolved permission block the proposed new work.

D3.instructions: Select the member assigned by the explicit case owner or mandatory executor. Do not replace an assigned member based on perceived ability.

criteria.claude: claude-c1 or Claude Code or claude-8d

D4.instructions: What reasoning depth does the stated task need? Classify the requested operation, not the general complexity of physics mentioned in its source.

criteria.standard: Direct extraction, file metadata, checksum comparison or simple restatement; no proof audit.
criteria.deep: Proof verification, domain-sensitive mathematics, adversarial multi-step audit or technical planning.

D5.instructions: Does the cited delivery satisfy the precise criterion stated in this case, at the documented scope? Do not infer a full trace from a partial theorem. A yes is consultative pre-audit only, never final board approval.

D6.instructions: Does the candidate sentence misstate or exceed the source evidence or scope? Flag unqualified empirical CONFIRMED and denial of an explicitly documented mathematical sub-proof. Scoped mathematical validity does not require empirical 5 sigma. An explicitly located OPEN gap is honest. Judge the candidate sentence, not words quoted merely as warnings.

D7.instructions: Does the proposed action require an explicit pending operator decision under the cited local rule? Publication and opening data for verdict do. Routine read-only lookup or checksum measurement does not. Do not grant authorization.

D8.instructions: Are the two candidate records mutually incompatible for the same object, scope, version and time? Different scopes or explicitly different dates/versions alone are not contradictions. A scoped theorem and an OPEN larger construction can coexist.
